# OverflowBar

> OverflowBar is a free, open-source macOS menu bar manager that moves selected supported icons into a second row.

## Product

- Select supported menu bar items in Settings, enable hiding, then use the OverflowBar arrow to open the second row.
- It does not manage every icon obscured by a MacBook notch. Protected controls and items without a safe, stable identity are excluded.
- It does not provide search, saved visibility profiles, or a global toggle shortcut.

## Compatibility and permissions

- The current release targets macOS 15 and macOS 26 with a universal Apple silicon and Intel build. Physical macOS 15 and Intel testing is incomplete.
- Native icon management is disabled on macOS 27 and later; runtime behavior on those versions has not been tested.
- Accessibility permission is required for arrangement and activation. Screen Recording permission is optional and enables live previews.
- Captures stay on your Mac. The updater contacts GitHub for updates.
- Community builds are not notarized.

## License and project

- OverflowBar is licensed under GPL-3.0 and includes contributions from Ice and Thaw.
